metaDescription: Order custom cotton poly nursing scrubs in bulk for your team. Soft, durable, and perfect for embroidery. Get a quote today.
introHtml: Cotton poly nursing scrubs combine the breathability of cotton with the wrinkle resistance and durability of polyester, making them a top choice for healthcare professionals who need uniforms that hold up to daily washing and wear. The blended fabric also provides a smooth surface for crisp embroidery or screen printing of your facility's logo or staff names. Whether you're outfitting a hospital floor or a private practice, these scrubs offer comfort and a polished, professional look that lasts.
